rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 "Phase 1: Run the curated skill on your feature and save the map" (lines 22-39): the header claims two actions, run the skill on your feature and save the map. The chunk's own content (lines 24-37) only confirms which skills are installed — the `/skills` command, then a prompt asking Claude to list installed skills, their storage location, and whether they're loaded onto context. It never invokes the skill on the student's feature and never saves a map; that action happens in the next chunk, "Point the skill at your feature" (lines 41-53), under a differently-worded, unnumbered header. Unresolved carryover from the 2026-07-12 audit — this fix pass touched chunk 1 (new opener), chunk 4 (m3-quality/test-strategy wording), and chunk 7 (sharpen wording), not chunk 2's header/content split.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Retitle chunk 2 to what it actually delivers (e.g. "Phase 1: Confirm the skill is on hand"), or fold the invoke-and-save prompt into the chunk carrying the "Phase 1: Run...and save the map" header — same fix named at the prior audit, not yet applied.
